name: Motionverse

name: Chigoma

record: Commercial films, documentary client stories, and retention-driven campaign reels across the KR8 DIGITALS ecosystem.

name: Next Gen Scholars
blurb: Dedicated academic education partner powering the Sciences, Arts, WAEC, and JAMB preparation pathway alongside KR8 Academy's digital tracks.
long: Next Gen Scholars leads the academic arm of KR8 DIGITALS' tuition-free educational mission. While KR8 Academy equips learners with market-ready digital crafts, Next Gen Scholars prepares secondary and pre-university students across Sciences and Arts for WAEC and JAMB examinations — ensuring young learners command both academic foundations and practical digital capability.
contribution: Structured academic instruction, WAEC & JAMB examination readiness, and student academic mentorship.
record: Active academic pathway operating alongside KR8 DIGITALS' free training ecosystem.
